description: DUNGEONKIT demo built only from the dungeon, props, cave, temple and lake kits: a lakeside approach and one dungeon floor (gatehall, passage, pit hall, key vault, the sealed door and the sanctum beyond). Original names and designs.

endings.text: The sanctum fire takes your hand's warmth and gives it back. The way home is lit.

flags.description: The block sits on the plate; the vault gate is up
The indigo key from the vault chest

interactions.label: Read the waystone
interactions.text: Jade glyphs glow faintly under the moss: a door, a key, a fire. Someone has scratched a small boat beside them.

interactions.label: Talk to Maren
interactions.text: Maren trims a wick and hands you a spare lantern. "The vault gate wants weight on its plate, not a key. The key is for the big door. Mind the pit."

interactions.label: Read the rune tablet
interactions.text: Three glyphs, worn smooth: stone on stone, key in iron, fire at the end.

interactions.label: Push the carved block
interactions.text: You set your shoulder to the block. It grinds onto the plate, and somewhere the gate rises.

interactions.label: Open the chest
interactions.text: Under a fold of oilcloth lies a heavy indigo key, cold as lake water.

interactions.label: Turn the indigo key
interactions.text: The key turns. The sigil dims, the lock falls, and the great door breathes out.

interactions.label: Warm your hands at the altar
interactions.text: The old fire leans toward you as if it knew you would come.

metadata.dungeonkit_note: Built only from DUNGEONKIT kits (kits/core/gen_dungeon/dprops/cave/temple.py) by data: tools/dungeonkit_rooms.py snaps every piece to the DUNGEON GRID and checks the socket manifest kits/library/dungeonkit-sockets.json. Generated by tools/dungeonkit_demo.py.

rooms.description: Stillwater at dusk. Stepping stones cross the dark lake to a gate cut into the cliff, and a thin waterfall talks to itself on the far side.
rooms.name: Stillwater Shore

rooms.description: The gatehall. Six torches burn under a ribbed vault; two hooded guardians lean on their swords beside the inner door.
rooms.name: The Gatehall

rooms.description: A narrow passage, a torch at each door and one midway, and a side branch choked with fallen stone.
rooms.name: The Long Passage

rooms.description: A hall split by a black pit. A narrow slab bridge is the only way across.
rooms.name: The Pit Hall

rooms.description: A vault behind the pit. A carved block sits beside a pressure plate, and a barred gate guards the north door. An old chest waits under the jade obelisk's light.
rooms.name: The Key Vault

rooms.description: A long hall of carved columns. At its end a towering door, sealed with a sigil and a heavy iron lock, waits between two braziers.
rooms.name: The Sealed Door

rooms.description: Beyond the great door a small sanctum keeps an old fire burning on its altar.
rooms.name: The Sanctum

tide.wait_text: Water drips somewhere in the dark.

title: The Drowned Gate
